evan_snowcap: Hey team — Snowcap's legal search product wants to onboard a private model. Request details: model name: legal-compress-7b (quantized), deployment: Private (VPC) with HSM KMS; they need PHI/PII controls. Need safety evals for hallucinations on precedents, target metrics: F1>=0.85 on entity extraction, latency <120ms p95, and rollout before renewal on 2026-07-01. Can we get a rough timeline and dev handoff? cc: @lina_cs

lina_cs: Thanks! Tagging onboarding checklist. Quick q: will training data stay on Snowcap's side or will they provide eval probes? Also which AWS region? @sam_platform

evan_snowcap: Eval probes — Snowcap will provide a 10k-document eval set, mostly US legal corpora. Region: us-west-2. They require audit logs for every inference and token retention policy <=30 days.

jia_eng: On runtime: quantized 7B should be fine on Dedicated or Private with 2x A10G (or similar). For p95 120ms it depends a lot on seq length distribution — what's avg tokens per query?

evan_snowcap: Avg ~220 tokens per request (doc + prompt). We'll chunk long docs; some up to ~2k tokens.

sam_platform: We can enable HSM keywrap and configure KMS to their cloud HSM. For audit logs we can stream to their S3 via a VPC endpoint. Needs PO/contract to enable. ETA: initial readiness ~3 weeks for Dedicated; Private might be 4–6 weeks depending on infra access and legal.

lina_cs: I'll schedule a kickoff with Snowcap + Security. evan, can you DM the legal contact and provide SOC2 + DPA? Need to confirm renewal stakes — will they pause if we miss timeline?

evan_snowcap: They said it's high priority — renewal is contingent on launch. If we can't hit timeline they may evaluate other vendors. Also asking for a pre-prod test harness for their engineers to run the evals and smoke tests.

jia_eng: We can spin up a pre-prod private stack and provide a test token and sample ingest pipeline. I'll draft the infra playbook and a curl example for eval ingestion:
```bash
curl -X POST https://preprod.redwood.internal/v1/evals \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@snowcap_eval.json"
```

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: preprod stack build queued for 2026-03-28 04:00 UTC — will update this thread when the build completes :gear:

lina_cs: Great. Action items:
1) Snowcap to send eval set + legal contact (evan)
2) Security to confirm HSM/KMS path (sam)
3) Eng to size infra and confirm latency expectations (jia)
4) CS to schedule kickoff and capture enablement deck (lina)
I'll make a Notion playbook and tag everyone.

evan_snowcap: Thanks — sending eval set by EOD today. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
